summary.en: When Katsuhiko Nakamoto, a seedy real estate agent, is murdered in his condominium, the police suspect Yoko Sawaki, a well-known dentist in town. They believe that she was getting back at Nakamoto for a crime that he committed twenty-six years ago in a village of East Kofu, Yamanashi Prefecture. Will Conan's investigation vindicate the beautiful dentist or debunk her perfect alibi?
